tokens.name: sky-top
tokens.usage: Top of the desktop sky gradient (page background).

tokens.name: sky-mid
tokens.usage: Middle of the sky gradient; the page's flat fallback colour.

tokens.name: sky-low
tokens.usage: Horizon of the sky gradient.

tokens.name: aurora
tokens.usage: Soft light bloom in the sky (radial glow, top-left).

tokens.name: aurora-soft
tokens.usage: Diagonal aurora streak across the sky.

tokens.name: cloud
tokens.usage: Soft clouds painted into the page background, so glass has something to blur.

tokens.name: bubble
tokens.usage: Rings of the floating bubbles in the page background.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Base tint of clear frosted glass: windows, panels, media bar, track lists. Always with blur-glass, the sheen and the rim. Ink text only.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Denser glass for reading: inputs, list rows on hover, footers, labels on tiles. ink-muted is allowed on it.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Bright 1px rim on the top and left edges of glass (where light hits) and around gloss controls.

tokens.name: glass-edge-low
tokens.usage: Dim rim on the bottom and right edges of glass, and inner hairlines.

tokens.name: glass-sheen
tokens.usage: Start of the diagonal light sheen and the curved top-left reflection on glass.

tokens.name: glass-sheen-end
tokens.usage: Where the sheen fades out, about a third of the way across.

tokens.name: glass-glow
tokens.usage: Light caught in the bottom edge of glass (inner glow).

tokens.name: glass-solid
tokens.usage: Solid stand-in for glass when the viewer asks for reduced transparency or blur is unsupported.

tokens.name: glass-shine
tokens.usage: Inner top highlight line and the start of title-bar shine.

tokens.name: gloss-top
tokens.usage: Start of the white shine over the top half of glossy buttons, orbs and tiles.

tokens.name: gloss-fade
tokens.usage: End of that shine, at about half height.

tokens.name: gloss-glow
tokens.usage: Light glowing up through the bottom of gloss buttons and orbs.

tokens.name: gloss-halo
tokens.usage: Soft halo around gloss controls on hover.

tokens.name: icon-emboss
tokens.usage: 1px lip under ink icons and text on glass, so they look pressed into it.

tokens.name: gloss-depth
tokens.usage: Inner bottom shadow and inset shading that make gloss feel round.

tokens.name: reflect
tokens.usage: Floor reflection under app tiles.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Active row in a track list.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text and icons on glass, glass-strong and the sky.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (artists, times, hints) on glass-strong only, or on glass over the lower sky.

tokens.name: ink-on-light
tokens.usage: Text on light aqua highlights in both themes.

tokens.name: on-color
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on blue, green, aqua and red gloss.

tokens.name: on-orange
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on orange gloss.

tokens.name: blue-light
tokens.usage: Top of the blue gloss gradient.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Primary actions and the main play orb. Mid tone of the gloss; label contrast is measured here.

tokens.name: blue-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom of the blue gloss gradient and its 1px rim.

tokens.name: green-light
tokens.usage: Top of the green gloss gradient.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Go / accept / confirm, success. Mid tone of the gloss; label contrast is measured here.

tokens.name: green-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom of the green gloss gradient and its 1px rim.

tokens.name: aqua-light
tokens.usage: Top of the aqua gloss gradient.

tokens.name: aqua
tokens.usage: Selected states, slider fills, highlights, app tiles. Mid tone of the gloss; label contrast is measured here.

tokens.name: aqua-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom of the aqua gloss gradient and its 1px rim.

tokens.name: red-light
tokens.usage: Top of the red gloss gradient.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Decline, delete, close on hover. Never decoration. Mid tone of the gloss; label contrast is measured here.

tokens.name: red-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom of the red gloss gradient and its 1px rim.

tokens.name: orange-light
tokens.usage: Top of the orange gloss gradient.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Warm accent: download, warnings, attention badges. Text on it is on-orange. Mid tone of the gloss; label contrast is measured here.

tokens.name: orange-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom of the orange gloss gradient and its 1px rim.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px focus ring, offset 2px, on every control.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error text on glass-strong.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Greetings and screen headlines. Light weight, sentence case.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Fresh music picked for a clear blue day.

styles.name: item
styles.usage: List and card titles, button labels.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Column headers and small section links, uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, tight insets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons, list-row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and window padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button side padding, page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Window controls, cover art.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Windows, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass panels, media bar, app tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large app tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, search fields, chips, slider tracks.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Orb buttons and slider knobs.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind every glass surface.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target on touch screens (buttons, orbs, window controls, sliders).

tokens.name: target-min-pointer
tokens.usage: Smallest click target with a mouse.

tokens.name: bp-compact
tokens.usage: Below this (phones) type steps down, padding tightens to space-3.

tokens.name: bp-wide
tokens.usage: Above this a sidebar layout fits beside the content.

tokens.name: bp-media-stack
tokens.usage: MediaBar stacks into one column below this width of its own container.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Soft lift under windows and panels.

tokens.name: shadow-gloss
tokens.usage: Small drop shadow under glossy buttons, orbs, chips and knobs.
